title: Manner Clauses: como and según + indicative or subjunctive
goal: Say how something is done with como and según, with the indicative for a known way and the subjunctive for an open one.
grammar: como and según + indicative or subjunctive

items: I can use *como* + verb for "the way" and "however".
I can use *según* + verb for "as" and "depending on how".
I can choose the indicative for a known way and the subjunctive for an open one.
